records.matter: Challenger launch recommendation reversal and engineer opposition
records.qualification_basis: Morton Thiokol engineers responsible for the solid rocket motor field joint and O-ring assessment.

source_packets.supports: Initial no-launch recommendation below 53 degrees, continuing engineer opposition, management reversal, and launch decisionmakers unaware of the opposition.
Post-testimony reassignment of dissenting engineers and later restoration of Allan McDonald after congressional and NASA pressure.

records.source_supports: A contractor engineering warning was reversed at management level, dissent disappeared inside an apparent organizational recommendation, launch proceeded, and dissenters were later reassigned.
source_does_not_establish: one individual gateholder motive or psychological state
the complete personnel record for every dissenting engineer
that every NASA decisionmaker received the underlying engineering evidence before launch
a final K0 disposition without field-level causal adjudication

records.matter: Columbia foam-strike imagery request denied by mission management
records.qualification_basis: NASA engineers assessing the STS-107 foam strike and orbiter damage risk.

source_packets.supports: Engineers requested high-resolution imagery to complete a more thorough analysis; managers turned down the request before re-entry.

records.source_supports: A qualified technical team requested an evidence channel and mission management denied it before the fatal re-entry.
source_does_not_establish: an explicit competence, loyalty, or attitude reclassification of the requesting engineers
an explanation-before and explanation-after mutation
that high-resolution imagery would necessarily have enabled a successful repair or rescue
a complete CCD chain

records.matter: NDK Crystal pressure-vessel warnings and inspection failures
records.qualification_basis: The pressure-vessel manufacturer and a third-party safety auditor with vessel-design and inspection expertise.

source_packets.supports: Annual inspection recommendations, a direct 2007 auditor warning against returning vessels to service, continued operation without inspection, and the fatal 2009 rupture.

records.source_supports: The company continued operating after source-explicit technical warnings and without the recommended inspections; a catastrophic rupture killed a member of the public.
source_does_not_establish: a documented reclassification of the manufacturer or auditor as incompetent or disloyal
the exact explanation mutation used by each company or regulator decisionmaker
one personal decision chain across the company and state oversight system
a complete K0 event without field adjudication

records.matter: East River doors-off helicopter pilot warnings disregarded
records.qualification_basis: Liberty pilots with direct operational knowledge of the harness, tether, emergency-egress, and aircraft-control risks.

source_packets.supports: Pilots repeatedly raised predicted harness, egress, control-entanglement, and flotation concerns that management disregarded.
Five passenger deaths, deficient safety management, foreseeable tether and egress risks, operational-control problems, and inadequate FAA oversight.

records.source_supports: Operational specialists predicted multiple hazards that later contributed to the crash and deaths; official investigation found deficient safety management.
source_does_not_establish: the exact wording and recipient of every pilot warning
a competence or loyalty reclassification applied to a bounded pilot
the complete employment or retaliation record
a continuous CCD chain without docket-level review

records.matter: Grenfell resident safety warnings and institutional nonresponse
records.institution: Kensington and Chelsea TMO / RBKC / central building-safety system
records.qualification_basis: Grenfell residents possessed situated knowledge of their building, landlord response, and recurring safety conditions; professional and governmental recommendations supplied additional technical warning channels.

source_packets.supports: Residents were ignored when raising safety issues; the institutional culture resisted external scrutiny and failed to track or act on fire-safety recommendations.
The final report exposed ignored safety risks, failures to listen to residents, and systemic failures preceding the fire.

records.source_supports: Situated and professional warning channels were institutionally discounted within a system that resisted scrutiny; the fire killed 72 people.
source_does_not_establish: one bounded gateholder or one warning-to-decision transaction
a single competence reclassification applied to all residents or advisers
that every resident concern was technically correct or causally material
a complete event without decomposing the distributed institutional chain

records.matter: Cape Douglas sinking without a documented pre-action qualified contradiction

source_packets.supports: Completed investigation, flooding, open watertight doors, no injuries, and total vessel loss.

records.source_supports: The official record establishes an accident and operational causes.
source_does_not_establish: a qualified warning reaching the decision surface before the sinking
a knower reclassification or explanation mutation
a retaliatory or exclusionary gate action
a ceiling-conversion event

records.matter: Repeated DOT-111 tank-car recommendations and recommendation persistence
records.institution: NTSB / PHMSA / FRA / railroad and tank-car regulatory system

source_packets.supports: Repeated NTSB warnings about DOT-111 vulnerability, reiterated phase-out recommendations, and a 2024 derailment with hazardous-material releases.
Accident findings, recommendation set, and investigation status.

records.source_supports: The record preserves a long-lived warning and recommendation stream across accidents and regulators.
source_does_not_establish: one bounded gate action preceded by one delivered contradiction
a competence reclassification or explanation mutation
that all delayed phase-out decisions shared one motive or decision chain
a K0 event rather than a recommendation-persistence surface
